_about: Rules you may change. How to judge a site is in references/judge.md. The rule for each client is in its ideal customer file (fit_rule) or in --rule.
_min_confidence: Below this, the answer is 'unsure' and a person checks it.
_usd_per_ai_check: About what one AI check costs. Shown in the approval ask. It is for the default low-cost model; a larger AI_MODEL in .env costs more.
_approval_above: A run that needs more AI checks than this waits for a person to approve it.
_fetch_max_bytes: Only the first part of the home page is read.
_min_text_chars: A page with less text than this is 'error' (too little to judge), not 'not fit'.
_max_page_chars: How much of the page text the AI reads.
_workers: Sites checked at the same time.
parked_phrases: the domain name is for sale
